doc: A rifle squad 44 m from two unarmed, unkillable dummies stacked 8 m apart. Constant: attack dummy A for two turns. Retarget: attack A, then switch to B at the start of turn 2. Measures what the switch costs in turn 2: total damage, and the seconds to the first shot at B. Orders only land at turn starts in this format, so this is the turn-boundary retarget; a mid-turn retarget needs the Retarget reaction, which this runner does not play.

retarget.doc: Switches to dummy B at the start of turn 2.

retarget_mid.doc: Switches to dummy B 5 s (50 ticks) into turn 1, mid-turn: the cost of a retarget within a turn (U1Q2; 01 R9c measured 438 against 453 for 5 s).

probes.doc: Turn 2: total damage to any enemy, constant (base) or after the switch (retarget).
Seconds into turn 2 to the first shot at B: the cost of the switch.
Turn 2 of the constant target keeps firing at once.
Total HP dealt in the run, to either dummy: the whole cost of the retarget (base: A for both turns; retarget_mid: A for 5 s, then B for the rest).
Turn 1, first 5 s: damage to A (the same in both: the switch has not happened yet).
Turn 1, last 5 s: damage to A. The constant target keeps firing at A; retarget_mid has stopped.
Turn 1, last 5 s: damage to B after the mid-turn switch.
Seconds from the mid-turn switch to the first shot at B.
